name: pfx_midi
title: OS-PFXTAB: a MIDI track with Chord 20 and Arp 6 sends the notes of this OS's tables (captured on the MIDI out and compared with the tables of docs/specs/OS-PFX.md). The scenario writes the pattern itself, with keys and the encoder (the loaded project in RAM only, nothing is saved), on track 2 of the pattern in view

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)

steps.say: OS-PFXTAB (docs/specs/OS-PFX.md; the expected notes are its tables): the Chord and Arp values play the notes of this OS's tables. The scenario CAPTURES what the unit's MIDI out sends, over a raw MIDI node of the USB MIDI port (--midi-device /dev/snd/midiC<card>D<dev>, see midi_clock_tool.py list) and compares the note-ons with the tables. The scenario WRITES the one pattern it needs (the loaded project, in RAM; nothing is saved): on track 2, row 1, a note with instrument 49 (MIDI channel 1), FX1 = Chord 20 (37A: Min7, root + 3, 7, 10 semitones; picker place 36, value by pad 32) and FX2 = Arp 6 (up, a note every step: 48 microsteps; picker place 37, value by pad 9), through the held Vol and Fx popups, as a person would; there is no OFF on row 7 (the arp goes on to the end of the capture, which is all the check needs). Variants to repeat by hand (the same capture, the expectation in brackets): Chord 0 with Arp 6 is the chromatic arpeggio [0 1 2 ... 11 0 1]; Chord 9 (5C) with Arp 6 arps 0 5 0 5 and the chord alone sends 0 5 12 together; Chord 12 (7E) with Arp 6 arps 0 7 0 7, the chord alone 0 7 14; Arp 17 (down) with Chord 20 [10 7 3 0 10 7]; Arp 5 (96 microsteps: a note every two steps) with Chord 20 [0 3 7 10] over 8 steps

WRITE THE PATTERN: Edit mode, track 2 row 1 (home, then the NOTE column), a note, instrument 49 by one detent down from instrument 1, the Chord on FX1 and the Arp on FX2 through the held-button popups.

steps.note: F6 steps down to instrument 1 (Shift + pad plays it, it does not select), so that one detent down is 49

Chord 20 + Arp 6 up: the tones of 37A in order, a step apart, then round again (the tables of docs/specs/OS-PFX.md: value 20 = 0 3 7 10; Arp 6 = up, 48 microsteps)
